column1: # Base event-arm expectation for NE8: one row per corpus document the base route answered on its event arm.
# built from a git archive of the base revision outside the worktree; the copy's .lake is this repository's build of the same revision's Lean modules, read only.
# columns: path exit verdict nk nxp ndst nev err arena_sha256 events_sha256 doc_sha256 stdout_sha256
# arena_sha256/events_sha256 are SHA-256 over the payload bytes the line carries (decoded from its hex); an empty payload hashes to the empty-string digest.
# doc_sha256 is the document file's SHA-256; stdout_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the base route's whole stdout for the row.
